# Waffle House Hash Browns — Table of Six

## The Order (Every Plate Different)

Using the official Waffle House hash brown vocabulary, here are six distinct plates:

1. **Scattered, Smothered** — spread on the grill with onions
2. **Scattered, Covered** — with melted cheese
3. **Scattered, Chunked** — with diced hickory-smoked ham
4. **Scattered, Diced** — with diced tomatoes
5. **Scattered, Peppered** — with jalapeño peppers
6. **Scattered, Capped** — with grilled mushrooms

*(The full official vocabulary, for reference: Scattered, Smothered, Covered, Chunked, Diced, Peppered, Capped, Topped [chili], Country [sausage gravy], and All the Way.)*

---

## The Call-Back From the Grill

When the server "calls the order," the grill operator repeats it back. It sounds something like this:

> *"Order in! Six hash browns, all workin'!*
> *One smothered!*
> *One covered!*
> *One chunked!*
> *One diced!*
> *One peppered!*
> *One capped!*
> *Six plates, all the way down the line — pull 'em when they're golden!"*

The grill cook drops six mounds across the flat-top, "marks" each one differently as they scatter
